title: Unchecked Balancer settle return value in PromotionUniV2_Eth.unlockCallback
description: The Balancer V3 settle() return value inside unlockCallback (the pay -> swap -> settle -> sendTo sequence) is not checked.
impact: Informational only — safe by construction. Balancer V3 unlock() reverts if transient debt is not fully settled, so any shortfall reverts the entire pool() call regardless of whether the settle return is inspected. No value leak, no availability impact => QA.
c4Justification: Balancer V3 unlock reverts on unsettled transient debt, so the unchecked return cannot admit a shortfall => informational QA.
recommendation: Optionally assert the settle() return equals the paid amount for clarity; the unlock-level revert already enforces settlement.
